messages:
Ivy: Hypothetical for the room 80: we	2re burying a tiny Redwood time capsule to open in 10 years. If you could pick ONE small, non-sensitive item from the office to include, what would it be and why?
Marcus: My old magnetic sticker of a pixel heart from the hackday. Nostalgia points.
Tanya: A single office plant leaf pressed in laminate  symbol of how we somehow keep things alive.
Rico: A USB with a single file: a playlist called "Soundtrack of Sprint 42" :musical_note:
Ivy: Also accepting absurd entries. 
Marcus: Vote for the playlist. Also adding: a tiny handwritten note to Future Redwood.
office-bot: Poll created: "Pick one item for the 10y time capsule"  Options: Pixel Heart Sticker / Pressed Plant Leaf / Sprint Playlist USB / Handwritten Note / Other
Tanya: Vote cast: Pressed Plant Leaf :herb:
Rico: Vote cast: Sprint Playlist USB :headphones:
Marcus: Vote cast: Pixel Heart Sticker :heart:
Ivy: Voted Other ("A single coffee ring from the conference table" for authenticity)
Marcus: If playlist wins I will curate the list and include a readme describing each song.
Tanya: If plant leaf wins I will laminate it and write the plant's name.
Rico: Also proposing we include one silly group selfie. Very high risk, high reward.
Ivy: Agreement: whoever suggested the selfie supplies the mini polaroid tape.
office-bot: Reminder set: time-capsule-initiative meeting in #random tomorrow at 11am.
Marcus: Love this. Low-effort, high-ceremony. When we bury it, can we pick a weird spot?
Tanya: Agree. But not literally bury in the courtyard	2: logistics. Maybe a locked box in the server-room-like-closet?
Rico: Can we at least engrave the box: "DO NOT OPEN — unless you're from 2034"
Ivy: Done. Thread wrap-up: bring ideas to tomorrow's quick sync. Also: whoever voted Other owes us a tale about that coffee ring.
Tanya: I'll prototype a tiny label and drop in #random by EOD.
office-bot: Thread archived to #random after 12 hours.
